title: SearXNG (web search)
description: A SearXNG instance, yours or one you may use, as gohort's web search, declared as a service: the request and how its results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: The instance must answer JSON: in its settings.yml, search: formats must list json. The connector takes no key. Choose it under Capabilities > Web Search and give the instance's address there; Test there makes one real search for a common phrase. An instance behind a proxy that wants a key: declare a secret setting sent as bearer in its spec's config, name it in auth in place of none, and give the key under the choice.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; Web Search lists it by this name.

config.name: base_url
config.label: Instance address
config.help: Where the instance is, with the path it is under if it has one: https://searx.example.com, or http://localhost:8888 for one on this machine.
